content.text: You’ve built a digital product—an ebook, a course, or a set of templates. But when you try to sell it, payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in Kenya. They lock you out. This isn’t just an inconvenience; it’s a barrier to your livelihood. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-5|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-selling-digital-art-without-paypal-3|architecture]] you own. No platforms. No subscriptions. No KYC. Just your store, your products, and your customers. This system uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, combined with crypto payment processing via NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-6|Tron USDT]]. You deploy it once, and it’s yours forever. This post explains how it works, why it matters, and how to deploy it today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways are not just about avoiding identity verification. They’re about infrastructure sovereignty. In Kenya, where Stripe and PayPal are restricted, digital creators need a system that doesn’t rely on third-party approval. This architecture is built on open tools and crypto payments. It’s not a patch; it’s a complete stack. You host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. The system is automated, secure, and fully yours. No platform can shut you down. No subscription can expire. This is commerce infrastructure you own, not rent.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how the pieces fit together. Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which are free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—both serverless and scalable. When a customer buys your product, the payment is processed via NOWPayments. The moment the crypto transaction confirms on-chain, a webhook triggers automatic product delivery. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack. File delivery happens via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring fast, reliable access. The entire system is stateless and decoupled. No single point of failure. No dependency on a third party. You deploy it once, and it runs indefinitely. This is how infrastructure sovereignty works in practice.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment gateways are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this is for you. It’s not a solution for those who want a plug-and-play platform. It’s for creators who value ownership over convenience. In Kenya, where financial isolation is a reality, this architecture gives you control. You’re not waiting for Stripe or PayPal to approve your region. You’re not at the mercy of currency collapses or payment rejections. This is commerce infrastructure designed for resilience, not fragility. It’s for creators who choose to build on a foundation they own.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership, not renting.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is modular but integrated. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide static hosting—fast, free, and globally accessible. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, from payment verification to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, ensuring you retain full ownership. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your digital products securely. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and sovereignty. Together, they form a complete commerce stack. You don’t need to manage servers or worry about scalability. The system is designed to work out of the box, with minimal maintenance required.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours, using GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration included. For full control, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates for instant download. Once deployed, load your products, set your crypto prices in USD, and start selling. The system handles the rest. Payments are verified on-chain, products are delivered automatically, and order data is stored securely. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s permanent infrastructure. You own it. You control it. And it works anywhere, even where Stripe and PayPal don’t.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

No-KYC payment gateways for digital sellers are commerce systems that process payments without requiring identity verification. They use cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoins, processed through platforms like NOWPayments. These systems are built on open, serverless tools like Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Pages, and Supabase. They automate product delivery, store order data securely, and eliminate dependency on third-party platforms. The result is a fully sovereign commerce stack that digital creators own and control, with no risk of shutdown or restriction.
No KYC, no subscriptions, no platform dependency.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re ready to deploy this architecture, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints, templates, and guides you need. It includes step-by-step instructions for integrating NOWPayments, configuring Cloudflare Workers, and setting up automated product delivery. This isn’t a tutorial—it’s a complete toolkit for building your own sovereign commerce infrastructure. Download it instantly and start selling your digital products today, without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or any other third party.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or Complete Builder Kit. 2. Deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing and automatic webhook triggers. 6. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test end-to-end: Place a test order, verify payment, and confirm product delivery. 8. Launch your store and start selling globally, with no KYC or platform restrictions.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?
Yes, the Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints designed for non-technical users. You’ll need basic familiarity with web tools, but the system is pre-configured for ease of use.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and Solana. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. The system uses serverless tools like Cloudflare Workers and GitHub Pages. There’s no server management required.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime, but if it fails, the system logs the order and retries payment verification once the service is restored.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?
Yes. The architecture is stateless and decoupled, designed to handle increased traffic and product volume without additional configuration.
